description: Header file for the Starboard Image Decoding Module, providing API declarations for hardware accelerated image decoding support, including functions to check support and perform decoding.

methods.name: SbImageIsDecodeSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current platform supports hardware accelerated decoding of a specific mime type into a given SbDecodeTargetFormat.

methods.name: SbImageDecode
methods.description: Attempts to decode encoded image data into an SbDecodeTarget, possibly using a provided SbDecodeTargetProvider.
